auth.notes: HTTP Basic authentication with API key SID/secret or Account SID/Auth Token; S2S OAuth2 for apps; specific OAuth2 grant types not documented

evidence.snippet: To authenticate requests to the Twilio APIs, Twilio supports HTTP Basic authentication . Use your API key SID as the username and your API key secret as the password.
Use shared API_KEY credentials for production account REST and all 45 triggers; per-connection BASIC for account administration and cross-account tools; or account S2S OAuth for mapped actions.
